yt_description:
Ever wondered if there's a smarter way to sort than the classic Bubble Sort? 🤔 Meet Cocktail Sort (also known as Bidirectional Bubble Sort or Shaker Sort)! Watch as we visualize this fascinating algorithm that sweeps data back and forth, making it more efficient than its one-way cousin. 🍸✨

In this video, you'll learn:

✅ How Cocktail Sort works step-by-step
✅ Its advantages over Bubble Sort
✅ When to use (and when NOT to use) Cocktail Sort
✅ A cool visual representation that makes sorting fun!

Get ready to level up your sorting game! 🚀
